beats.care: Tonight's match at 7 pm decides the trophy. India haven't lost a home T20 series since 2019, so that run is on the line.
beats.what: West Indies beat India by 24 runs at Uppal on Wednesday after scoring 247 for 3. That levelled the five-match series at two wins each.
beats.why: Captain Shai Hope hit an unbeaten 102 off 50 balls, and Keemo Paul took five wickets, three of them in one over.

cards.body: India chased hard, with Sanju Samson top-scoring on 56, but finished 24 runs short.
cards.caption: West Indies' total at Uppal

cards.body: Showers are forecast in Bengaluru tonight. If rain cuts overs, the target gets reset using a formula, so wickets in hand matter as much as runs.
In a five-match series, the team with more wins takes the trophy. At 2-2, the last game is winner takes all.
cards.title: what's a series decider?

opts: The series was 2-2, so it decided the winner
India had already won the series
cards.q: Why did the fifth T20 in Bengaluru matter so much?
cards.why: With two wins each, whoever won the fifth match would take the series.

hook: Shai Hope's *50-ball 102* levelled it. Can India win the decider tonight?

learn.t: If West Indies win, it'll be India's first home T20 series loss since Australia beat them 2-0 in February 2019.

tldr: After West Indies won at Uppal, the T20 series is level at 2-2, and tonight's match in Bengaluru decides it.
watch: Toss at 6:30 pm, first ball 7 pm IST at Chinnaswamy, Bengaluru. Showers are forecast, so overs could be cut.
